summary: Iteration 8: Verified legal-page refresh (Terms, Refund→Booking & Cancellation Policy, Privacy — no Stripe/'paid in advance' anywhere), Vault Lockout (direct-function test still passes; /api/admin/vault/status now returns lock_frozen/lock_seconds_left/fails/max_fails), and Google Calendar sync no-op path + endpoint shapes. Booking Confirm/Reschedule/Decline all succeed via HTTP AND via admin UI even with calendar disconnected. New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8.py — 13/13 passing.
critical_code_review_comments: sync_booking_to_calendar swallows all exceptions silently (correct for no-op path) but logs at info — a real Google API failure would be hard to spot in production. Consider logger.exception for non-404 GCal errors.
GCAL_REDIRECT_URI is read at module load; if the preview domain rotates, OAuth callback URL will mismatch and connect will silently fail. Same caveat as WEBAUTHN_RP_ID/ORIGIN.
calendar_oauth_callback only accepts admin-allowlisted emails for state — good. But state JWT TTL is not explicit; verify _gcal_state_token sets a short exp (didn't inspect deeply).
server.py now ~2757 lines — split into routers (calendar/, vault/, bookings/) recommended.
publish-week testid only renders when current week != published week; UI shows the 'Published to visitors' badge instead (verified). Both branches are covered by tests.
test_credentials: Admin JWT minted via /app/backend/auth.create_access_token using admin user id f38ee7e0-033c-4c43-8a69-3bf31490e8e3 (sudarshan@karweers.com). Injected into localStorage 'sk_token' for UI bypass of hCaptcha.
seed_data_creation: One consultation doc (email prefix test-booking-ui-*) inserted directly to Mongo and cleaned up. app_meta 'google_calendar' deleted (was already absent). vault_lockouts entry for vaulttest@example.com created + cleaned by the vault_lockout script. app_meta 'availability' had one test block ('2026-08-31':['09:30']) added by UI toggle — cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration8.py + test_booking_flow.py + test_vault_lockout.py together cover: Stripe removal, booking lifecycle, availability, vault lockout, calendar sync no-op, legal pages. Google Calendar full OAuth cannot be automated (real Google consent). Admin JWT injection via localStorage 'sk_token' remains the reliable UI-auth bypass.
